## Summary Ports applicable Pi coding-agent changes from **v0.80.10 (`8dc78834`) through v0.81.1 (`20be4b18`)** and updates Atomic's `pi-agent-core`, `pi-ai`, and `pi-tui` pins to `^0.81.1`. The port preserves Atomic branding, bundled first-party packages, DBOS durability, Verbatim Compaction, hashline editing, and the versionless release flow. The exhaustive commit-by-commit classification is in [`research/docs/2026-07-21-pi-0.81.1-sync-audit.md`](research/docs/2026-07-21-pi-0.81.1-sync-audit.md). ## Upstream classification | Category | Upstream changes | Result / reason | |---|---|---| | **Ported** | Read-error rendering; compaction queue delivery; prompt all-argument defaults; duplicate session reads; shared UUIDv7 session IDs; lifecycle type exports; Qwen defaults/help; thinking-level RPC; deferred catalog refresh; stale persisted-catalog ordering; summarization retries/events; stream API compatibility; Kimi subscription indicator; extension-doc corrections; `brace-expansion` 5.0.7 | Adapted to Atomic's split modules and branding with regression coverage | | **Covered by dependency bump** | Pi TUI CRLF/cursor/paste fixes; OpenAI Responses early-EOF retry; model generation/catalog updates; Copilot pricing; OpenCode Go; GPT-5.6 catalog; cross-provider tool IDs; credential `env`; Kimi K3 thinking compatibility; Gemini/image catalogs; retry internals | Implementations live in `pi-ai`, `pi-tui`, or `pi-agent-core` 0.81.1; no duplicate copy | | **Skipped / deferred** | Local llama.cpp router and HF download UI | Large additive built-in overlaps Atomic package discovery; dedicated follow-up recommended | | **Skipped / deferred** | Full native `Provider` extension API | Atomic retains its compatibility `registerProvider(name, config)` contract; focused API migration required | | **Skipped / deferred** | Expanded durable usage accounting | Conflicts with Atomic's deletion-only Verbatim entries and DBOS/session extensions; dedicated follow-up recommended | | **Intentional Atomic divergence** | Upstream SQLite coding-session storage | Atomic keeps DBOS workflow durability and JSONL coding sessions | | **Not applicable** | Deterministic source archives, GitHub Actions/release/version stamps, npm lock bookkeeping, contributor/issue-template changes | Atomic's versionless detached release flow and Bun lock/shrinkwrap generation win | ## Changes - Regenerated `bun.lock`, root npm lock, and coding-agent shrinkwrap with exact 0.81.1 registry integrity metadata. - Restored persisted catalogs cache-only during service creation, deferred interactive/RPC network refresh, and prevented older overlays from replacing newer bundled catalogs. - Added retry-policy support and lifecycle events for Verbatim Compaction planning and branch summaries across interactive, JSON, RPC, and SDK consumers. - Added `get_available_thinking_levels`, root lifecycle event type exports, Qwen built-in defaults, and compatibility fallback for pre-0.81 extension streams. - Updated the Unreleased changelog, affected user docs, and the full upstream audit. ## Validation - `bun run typecheck` ✅ - `bun run lint` ✅ - `bun run test:unit` ✅ — 3,907 passed - `bun run test:integration` ✅ — 255 passed - `bun run check:file-length` ✅ — 2,329 checked - `bun run check:shrinkwrap` ✅ - `bun run --cwd packages/coding-agent docs:check` ✅ - `bun run --cwd packages/coding-agent build` ✅ - Focused coding-agent regressions ✅ — catalog ordering, retries, queue modes, RPC, prompt defaults, read rendering, provider stream compatibility - Built CLI smoke ✅ — `--version`, `--help`, offline RPC `get_available_thinking_levels`, and cache-only `refresh_models` ## Notes The broader coding-agent Vitest suite reached 2,729 passing tests; 12 platform/native-tool tests remain unrelated failures in PTY, tree-sitter/search native binaries, and stdout-cleanliness subprocess fixtures. All required repository gates and affected-area suites pass.

Greptile Summary

This PR ports Pi 0.81.1 coding-agent updates into Atomic. The main changes are: - Updated `pi-agent-core`, `pi-ai`, and `pi-tui` pins and regenerated lockfiles. - Added deferred model-catalog refresh behavior and bundled-catalog freshness checks. - Added summarization retry support and lifecycle events for compaction and branch summaries. - Added RPC support for available thinking levels. - Updated read-error rendering, stream compatibility, docs, changelog, and focused tests.

Confidence Score: 4/5

Mostly safe, with one contained catalog-staleness bug to fix. The PR has broad focused test coverage and the main flows are consistent with the changed code. The score is limited by the `404`/`501` remote-catalog path leaving stale dynamic models visible in the current process. `packages/coding-agent/src/core/remote-catalog-provider.ts`

T-Rex Logs

 **What T-Rex did** - Static verification confirmed the 404/501 handling path in packages/coding-agent/src/core/remote-catalog-provider.ts persists stored models but does not clear dynamicModels, and no runtime execution evidence or repro harness was produced before the step limit. - Ran the coding-agent CLI to verify version and help output, confirming 0.0.0 and that --help lists the available modes, with both commands exiting with code 0. - Launched an offline RPC smoke harness and captured traces showing get\_available\_thinking\_levels returning success with levels minimal, low, medium, high and refresh\_models with allowNetwork:false, with the RPC process exiting code 0. Ran code and verified through T-Rex

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | packages/coding-agent/src/core/remote-catalog-provider.ts | Adds local-vs-remote catalog freshness and refresh escalation logic; `404`/`501` handling leaves stale dynamic models published in-process. | | packages/coding-agent/src/core/model-registry.ts | Passes bundled catalog URLs into remote catalog wrappers so persisted overlays cannot replace newer built-ins. | | packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/branch-summarization.ts | Wraps branch summarization provider calls in retry policy callbacks while preserving abort/error handling. | | packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/range-planner.ts | Adds retry support to the compaction range planner stream call. | | packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session-compaction.ts | Uses the session stream function plus retry lifecycle callbacks for verbatim compaction planning. | | packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session-tree.ts | Uses the session stream function and retry lifecycle callbacks for branch summaries. | | packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-command-handler.ts | Adds RPC handling for `get_available_thinking_levels`. | | packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-model-catalog-startup.ts | Adds post-TUI catalog refresh orchestration and snapshot-based provider count updates. | | packages/coding-agent/test/remote-catalog-provider.test.ts | Adds remote catalog freshness and unavailable-route tests, though it misses the in-process stale-model assertion. |

Prompt To Fix All With AI `````markdown Fix the following 1 code review issue. Work through them one at a time, proposing concise fixes. --- ### Issue 1 of 1 packages/coding-agent/src/core/remote-catalog-provider.ts:129-132 **Clear unavailable overlays** When the catalog endpoint returns `404` or `501`, this path writes `lastModified: 0` but leaves `dynamicModels` populated from the cached `stored` entry loaded at line 113. A forced refresh after an endpoint is removed still exposes the old remote models for the current process, leaving users with stale model choices until restart. `````
